business_summary: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings, through its subsidiaries, provides excess and surplus lines insurance and reinsurance products to small and medium-sized businesses in the United States. The company offers property and casualty insurance solutions, including general liability, commercial property, management liability, miscellaneous PL, allied healthcare, and architects and engineers insurance products to the retail, real estate, hospitality, and construction sectors. It markets and distributes its products through brokerage and small business channels. The company was formerly known as Ategrity Specialty Holdings LLC and changed its name to Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings in June 2025. Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings was incorporated in 2017 and is based in New York, New York. Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings operates as a subsidiary of Zimmer Financial Services Group LLC.
business_summary_ko: Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings는 자회사를 통해 미국 내 중소기업에 초과 및 초과 보험과 재보험 상품을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 일반 책임, 상업용 재산, 관리 책임, 기타 PL, 연합 건강 관리, 건축가 및 엔지니어 보험 상품을 포함한 재산 및 상해 보험 솔루션을 소매, 부동산, 숙박 및 건설 부문에 제공합니다. 중개 및 중소기업 채널을 통해 제품을 마케팅하고 유통합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Ategrity Specialty Holdings LLC로 알려졌으며 2025년 6월에 이름을 Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings로 변경했습니다. Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings는 2017년에 설립되었으며 뉴욕주 뉴욕에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings는 Zimmer Financial Services Group LLC의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
